_comment: The Graph page's query catalogue (DATA, not code). Each entry is a
question a person brings to the graph, in their words, with the
Cypher that answers it. Parameters are named $params and bound by
the API — never interpolated. `render` says how the Studio shows
the rows: table, bar (first column = label, second = number), or
graph (rows carry Kùzu nodes/relationships, drawn on the canvas).
`intent` groups the catalogue the way Kiro Analyzer does:
search (find things), detail (one thing), pattern (across things).

queries.name: Which tools fail most, and where
queries.question: Across every session, which tool produced the most errors, and in how many sessions?
queries.cypher: MATCH (s:Session)-[:HAS_TURN]->(:Turn)-[:INVOKED]->(i:ToolInvocation)-[:PRODUCED_ERROR]->(e:ErrorNode) RETURN i.tool_name AS tool, count(e) AS errors, count(DISTINCT s) AS sessions ORDER BY errors DESC LIMIT 20

queries.name: Tools that most often precede an error
queries.question: When a tool call errored, which tool was called in the turn just before? (FOLLOWED_BY between turns)
queries.cypher: MATCH (p:Turn)-[:FOLLOWED_BY]->(t:Turn)-[:INVOKED]->(:ToolInvocation)-[:PRODUCED_ERROR]->(:ErrorNode) MATCH (p)-[:INVOKED]->(prev:ToolInvocation) RETURN prev.tool_name AS tool_before, count(*) AS errors_after ORDER BY errors_after DESC LIMIT 20

queries.name: Files touched by the most sessions
queries.question: Which files come up in the most sessions — the hot spots of a codebase?
queries.cypher: MATCH (s:Session)-[:HAS_TURN]->(:Turn)-[:INVOKED]->(:ToolInvocation)-[a:ACCESSED_FILE]->(f:FileNode) WHERE $project = '' OR s.project_path = $project RETURN f.path AS file, count(DISTINCT s) AS sessions, count(a) AS accesses ORDER BY sessions DESC, accesses DESC LIMIT 25

queries.name: Sessions most similar to one session
queries.question: Which sessions are closest to this one by meaning, with their scores? (SIMILAR_TO)
queries.cypher: MATCH (s:Session {session_key: $session})-[r:SIMILAR_TO]->(t:Session) RETURN s, r, t ORDER BY r.score DESC LIMIT 10

queries.name: A session and everything it ran on
queries.question: The workspace, model, copilot, developer and agents of one session, drawn.
queries.cypher: MATCH (s:Session {session_key: $session})-[r]->(m) WHERE label(m) IN ['Workspace','Model','Copilot','Developer','Agent'] RETURN s, r, m

queries.name: Which model runs the longest sessions
queries.question: Per model: sessions, average turns, average errors.
queries.cypher: MATCH (s:Session)-[:USED_MODEL]->(m:Model) RETURN m.name AS model, count(s) AS sessions, avg(s.turn_count) AS avg_turns, avg(s.error_count) AS avg_errors ORDER BY avg_turns DESC

queries.name: Sessions per project
queries.question: How much work went where: sessions, turns and errors per workspace.
queries.cypher: MATCH (s:Session)-[:IN_WORKSPACE]->(w:Workspace) RETURN w.path AS project, count(s) AS sessions, sum(s.turn_count) AS turns, sum(s.error_count) AS errors ORDER BY sessions DESC

queries.name: Errors by tool in one project
queries.question: Within one project, which tools error and how often?
queries.cypher: MATCH (s:Session)-[:IN_WORKSPACE]->(:Workspace {path: $project}) MATCH (s)-[:HAS_TURN]->(:Turn)-[:INVOKED]->(i:ToolInvocation)-[:PRODUCED_ERROR]->(e:ErrorNode) RETURN i.tool_name AS tool, count(e) AS errors ORDER BY errors DESC LIMIT 20

queries.name: Developers by sessions and errors
queries.question: Per developer: sessions, turns, errors.
queries.cypher: MATCH (s:Session)-[:BY_DEVELOPER]->(d:Developer) RETURN d.developer_id AS developer, count(s) AS sessions, sum(s.turn_count) AS turns, sum(s.error_count) AS errors ORDER BY sessions DESC

queries.name: What one session called, and what errored
queries.question: Every tool one session used, with calls and errors.
queries.cypher: MATCH (s:Session {session_key: $session})-[:HAS_TURN]->(:Turn)-[:INVOKED]->(i:ToolInvocation) RETURN i.tool_name AS tool, count(i) AS calls, sum(CASE WHEN i.is_error THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors ORDER BY calls DESC

queries.name: Similar sessions across different projects
queries.question: Pairs of sessions from different projects that the similarity pass linked — the same kind of work happening in two places.
queries.cypher: MATCH (a:Session)-[r:SIMILAR_TO]->(b:Session) WHERE a.project_path <> b.project_path RETURN a, r, b ORDER BY r.score DESC LIMIT 15
